summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns for July 13-17, 2026, reporting daily open-market share repurchases under its buyback program. The filing details a repurchase on July 10, 2026, of 320,146 A shares at an average price of ~USD 6.06, representing 0.0184% of outstanding non-treasury shares. The repurchased shares were held as treasury stock. These buybacks are part of a previously announced capital return program, not a formal tender offer. Watch for continued buyback pace and any potential cancellation of treasury shares, as this affects share count and EPS accretion.
